title: Sphere crash south of the border that killed a cow
place_text: about 100 miles south of the US border near Brownsville, Texas, east coast of Mexico

plain: A sphere is said to have crashed about 100 miles south of the US border near Brownsville, Texas, on Mexico's east coast, and the explosion killed a cow 100 meters away. Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants, tells it second-hand: a man named Massan bought the sphere from the farmer who owned the land and passed on the farmer's account. If true, it would be a recovered crashed object in private hands.
